title: Gaza genocide
summary: This record is the characterisation, held apart from the war it is about. A United Nations special committee and commission of inquiry, the International Association of Genocide Scholars, Amnesty International and Human Rights Watch, a number of governments and much of the genocide-studies literature have concluded that Israel's conduct in the Gaza Strip since October 2023 — the mass killing, the deliberate starvation, the destruction of hospitals, housing and universities, and statements of intent by senior officials — amounts to genocide. South Africa's case is before the International Court of Justice, which has ordered provisional measures and has not ruled on the merits. Israel and the United States reject the finding. The atlas records the disagreement rather than resolving it, and the edge from the war carries it.
